title: Comments state their rule, not the register
description: First half of the register-citation sweep, over files no in-flight phase declares; the measured occurrence list is in the orchestrator's scratchpad (idcite/occurrences.tsv). The held files and the lint that keeps the rule are P86.
desiredOutcome: Every comment and docstring in the files this phase declares states the constraint of its block instead of citing a plan, phase, task, bug, fault or design-table id; behaviour is unchanged and the whole suite stays green.

tasks.title: Panel comments state their rule, not the register
tasks.description: Rewrite each comment or docstring in this task's files that cites a register id - a phase or task id (P<n>, P<n>.<m>, P<n>.<m>-<suffix>, BF<n>), a bug id (BUG-<n>), a fault id (F<n>) or a design-table label (dg<n>, tk<n>) used as a citation - so that it states the constraint of its block, the thing the id stood for, in plain words. What an id meant can be read in the private register (quality-gates-internal/PLAN.md and its plans/), but the constraint is written fresh and no register text is copied into the public tree. Not citations, and left alone: a test's own case label passed to check(), an id illustrating an id SHAPE (--phase P3, P9 before P10, phases/P1.json), a rendered-output example quoted in backticks, ruff codes in a noqa list, and demo or fixture data. No behaviour changes, no string a test reads changes, and no number is written into prose. The measured occurrences are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-aleksandarbisevac-Desktop-personal-claude-plugins/3b036b96-92a2-4ce4-957f-53d389324eaa/scratchpad/idcite/occurrences.tsv (rows with is_real = yes); treat that as a pointer, verify every line, and report any real citation it missed in these files.
